en: An old sepia-toned postcard showing a railway station complex by the water. A long, low station building with a taller central section stands behind a row of train carriages. There are trees around the station and low hills or a shoreline in the distant background. A horse-drawn carriage is visible in the foreground along an empty road. The top left bears red Greek text, and at the bottom right there is a modern website watermark.
